title: For insurers

spec: Data Processing Agreement: roles, sub-processors with notice, residency in India, breach clock and erasure.

title: Legal: Cookies and local storage
spec: Cookies and local storage: what the site and console keep in the browser, and why.

title: Changelog
spec: Every change classed additive, breaking or fix, by surface and release train, linked to dated notices.

title: Docs
spec: “Integrate once, against a frozen contract.” The public doorway into the developer portal: SDK, MCP and HTTP, with a first call.

title: Status

title: Sign in

spec: Hand-off to the organisation’s identity provider (SAML or OIDC) with a clear way back, plus provider-refused and not-assigned outcomes.

title: Enter your code
spec: The one-time code or magic-link wait: 44 px targets, expired code and opened-on-another-device variants.

title: Second step
spec: Second factor by authenticator app, passkey or backup code; step-up is also used before irreversible approvals.

title: Sign up for a sandbox
spec: Work e-mail, company and a one-line description of what they intend to govern; a blocked account is told a person will read their message.

title: Check your e-mail
spec: “Check your e-mail. The key is on the other side of the link.” Variants for sandbox key, sign-in link and recovery.

title: Accept invitation
spec: Join a tenant: shows the role, the write types that role may approve and the level, with expired and already-accepted states.

title: Choose a tenant
spec: Tenant picker with residency, environment (Sandbox / Production) and assurance level per tenant.

title: Signed out
spec: Confirmation after signing out of this device or all devices, or after declining an invitation.

title: Session ended
spec: Idle timeout, and the stricter 15-minute rule before approving: sign in again and nothing was decided in the meantime.

title: Recover access
spec: Recover a lost sign-in or a lost second factor, with a person reading any recovery that touches an approver.

title: Set up elan1
spec: The eleven-step onboarding checklist from organisation to production key, with the minutes each takes and “Phase 1 has no self-serve production access”.

title: Onboarding: organisation
spec: Legal entity, turnover band and a named production owner — a person, not a list.

title: Onboarding: residency
spec: Residency domain India (ap-south-1) with the permanence warning, and the dedicated-domain option.

title: Onboarding: system of record
spec: Connect ERPNext (others shown as not yet available) and choose Enforced or Attested advisory per write type, in writing.

title: Onboarding: pack
spec: Choose ledger1, invoice1, collect1 or none, with each pack’s obligation and what it does not establish.

title: Onboarding: declaration
spec: Import or author the seven blocks, validate, simulate on the reference tenant and send for certification by someone else.

title: Onboarding: gates
spec: The nine gates with six locked on (consent, residency, retention, dual control, counterparty, precondition) and three configurable.

title: Onboarding: people
spec: Approvers and dual-control pairs; an agent can never be an approver.

title: Onboarding: first agent
spec: Register the first agent over SDK or MCP; every grant starts at A0 Observe.

title: Onboarding: sandbox proof
spec: Prove all three outcomes — committed, refused, escalated-then-resolved — against the sandbox chain, live.

title: Onboarding: production key
spec: Request production: conformance result, declaration version, residency, named owner; a person reviews within two working days.

title: Onboarding: done
spec: The level pill, the L1 sentence and next steps (pilot, auditor day 0).

title: Your profile
spec: The signed-in person: roles, resolver sets they decide in, delegations and the write types they may approve.

title: Preferences
spec: Theme, density, level preview, single-key shortcuts and language — per person, never per tenant policy.

title: Sessions and devices
spec: Where this person is signed in, with sign-out per device and for all devices.

title: Notifications
spec: Which events reach this person on which channel (web, e-mail, WhatsApp, voice), bounded by what each channel may approve.

title: Today
src: Four Doors v2.0; E06 §02; TM §6.1; IM §3.4; Brand Book
spec: The approver’s landing for Kaveri Spinning Mills: stat row (waiting on me, expiring within an hour, not done needing action, reversible writes still in window), the three nearest deadlines, recent proofs, and banners for a stopped tenant or platform incident.

title: Approvals
spec: The approval inbox, “the one a customer opens twenty times a day”: each row shows the proposal, who proposed it (Agent or Person in words), money or radius, “5 of 5 passed” and the countdown, oldest deadline first.

title: What arrives here
spec: The write types that escalate to this approver and why (autonomy below what the write needs, dual-control threshold, irreversible), with the channels where each may be approved.

title: Decide
src: E06 §03; E04 Flow 3; TM §6.1; atlas Fig 7; atlas Fig 11
spec: “The single most consequential surface in the product”, compiled from the declaration: the one-line proposal, proposer in words, deadline and blast radius above the fold; the field-by-field diff; every gate result; “allow at policy version 11” and why a person is needed; Approve and Reject.

title: Decide: dual control
src: E06 §03; E02 G4; E04; atlas Fig 11
spec: A supplier payment run of ₹18,42,760 that needs two named people: the G4 row reads “dual control: awaiting you”, the quorum shows who has recorded and who has not, and one approval alone commits nothing.

title: Decide: irreversible write
spec: Cancelling an e-invoice that cannot be undone: the Irreversible band, “cannot be auto-approved”, no reverse plan, and step-up before the gate button.

title: Decide: certify a declaration
spec: Certifying erp.ar v8 as a dual-control governed write: version N, compiled digest and the diff against N−1; the author can never certify.

title: Decide: autonomy grant
spec: Raising bank-recon-agent from A3 to A4 on one write type: the evidence behind it, the cap rules, and a second person deciding what the proposer asked for.

title: Decide: stop the tenant
spec: The second approval that throws the stop switch: cause class, reason, whole-tenant radius and the warning that every write, refusals included, halts at rung 0b.

title: Not done
spec: Refusals that need an action: when, what was tried, by whom, the plain reason, the code in small type, the one next action and the proof number.

title: Not done: refusal explained
src: E06 §04; E02 §06; E04 Flow 2; atlas Fig 6
spec: One refusal in the words of the thing tried (“Not done — budget used up for this period”): the code once in small type, the rule in one sentence with the two numbers, every gate result with the failed one first, one operator action, the proof link and “Not billed”.

title: Not done: our failure
spec: “This is our failure, not a rule. Nothing was changed, you have not been billed, and we have been paged.” A PLATFORM.* outcome with Try again on the same intent id.

title: Requests
spec: Changes people have asked for in words the declaration understands, with their outcome and proof, and the write types a person may request.

title: New request
spec: A form compiled from the write type’s payload schema; before Confirm it states whether the change will need a person, then shows Committed, Sent for approval or Not done.

title: Write status
spec: One governed write in flight or finished: every rung 0b–9 as a ladder, the outcome, the proof number and the reverse window.

title: Reverse this
spec: Reverse a committed write: the original and its proof, the undo window, the path the system chose (snapshot or compensating entry), the diff and the gates that will run — itself a governed write.

title: Obligations calendar
spec: Every deadline that will need a governed write: approvals the kernel opened, statutory dates (MSME 45 days, GST filings) and undo windows about to close.

title: Escalations
spec: Every escalation and how it ended — approved, rejected, expired, or approved but not done — each ending its own proof record.

title: Reviews
spec: Decisions a named person reads in full: production access and promotion reviews (elan1 operator tenant), graduation and receipt acceptance (your tenant).

title: Review: production access
spec: LedgerLoop asks for a production key: the four checks only, the attachments (conformance result, declaration version, residency, named owner) and quick-refuse reasons each with the sentence we say.

title: Review: promotion to Enforced
spec: Promote an agent from Attested advisory to Enforced: bypass-proof attempts, credential inventory, the rollback drill and the new certified declaration version.

title: Review: graduation A2 → A3
spec: The second named approver sees the numbers — counters, score_v1, the eight conditions and the supervised terms — and the proposer’s own justification, never a recommendation.

title: Review: receipt acceptance
spec: Bind a counterparty’s receipt into this chain under dual control: the verifier result as a gate input, discovery route, disclosed fields and the limits line.

title: Stop switch
spec: Ask to stop this workspace at rung 0b: cause class and reason, then a second named person decides. States for requested and stopped.

title: Break-glass
spec: “There is no admin mode.” Break-glass is a declared write type with dual control, recorded in the operator’s own chain, visible to the tenant, alerting within a minute.

title: Approvals on a phone
spec: The approval inbox at 360 px: rows become cards but keep all four facts — proposer kind, money or radius, checks passed, time left.

title: Decide on a phone
spec: Decide at 360 px: diff collapsed to the changed fields with Show all fields, every gate row, and 48 px Approve and Reject with a 12 px gap.

title: Decision recorded
spec: The phone confirmation: “Approved · posted · proof #4,101” with the record and reverse window.

title: WhatsApp approval
spec: The WhatsApp template, reply options and resulting states; approval only where the Channel Block allows it, with a link back to the full Decide.

title: Voice approval
spec: The rung1 voice-call script for an approval: what is read aloud, how a person confirms, and when the call hands over to the screen.

title: E-mail notification
spec: The e-mail that tells an approver something is waiting: proposal, proposer kind, deadline and one link to Decide — never an approve button in the e-mail.

title: Connected systems
spec: Each system of record (ERPNext at kaveri.rung1.in): host version, enforcement mode, declarations bound, last governed write and adapter status.

title: Connected system
spec: One system of record: reachability, mode per write type, the declarations bound to it and its recent governed writes.

title: Objects
spec: Governed objects by record type from the declarations — invoices, payments, stock entries — each linking to its governed timeline and out to ERPNext.

title: Object timeline
spec: Sales Invoice SINV-2026-01187: current state, pinned fields from the declaration, and every governed write that touched it with actor, kind, outcome and proof.

title: Declarations
spec: Declarations with slug, owner role, system of record, residency, certified version, certifier and status (Certified · In validation · Draft · Superseded).

title: Declaration
spec: erp.ar v7 in force: the seven blocks read-only with each field’s disposition, the version history with digests and certifiers, and where it is used.

title: Declaration version
spec: A superseded version kept verbatim: “Records written under version 6 still explain themselves.”

title: Compare declaration versions
spec: v6 → v7 block by block; loosening a gate names the ADR it needed.

title: Declaration Studio
spec: Drafts and versions in progress, with who is authoring and who may certify.

title: New declaration
spec: Start a declaration at block 1 of 7 (identity).

title: Studio: author
spec: Block-by-block editor for the seven blocks with a tri-state control per field and the compiled Decide preview beside the source.

title: Studio: validate
spec: Validation against the block that caused it (L0-S01…S11), lint warnings apart, and Simulate enabled only when valid.

title: Studio: simulate
spec: Runs each write type against the reference tenant’s fixtures: gates in order, resolved radius, meter basis and the refusals produced.

title: Studio: certify
spec: A named person presses Certify this version; the author is refused with GATE.DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_ACTOR and Send to.

title: Write types
spec: Every write type with blast radius, dual control, reversal plan or Irreversible, gates in order, channels, mode, meter basis and live-or-modelled coverage.

title: Write type
spec: erp.sales_invoice.submit: intent sentence, grants (role, actor kind, minimum autonomy, may approve), gates, reversal plan and the refusal codes it can reach.

title: Changesets and runs
spec: Overnight and agent runs with what each write touched, linked to the host and to proof entries.

title: Run
spec: The overnight close run for the August books: every write it attempted, committed, refused or escalated.

title: Actors and delegations
spec: People, agents and systems with kind in words, roles, what they may approve and delegations (on behalf of whom, until when).

title: Actor
spec: Venkat Raman, Person: roles, resolver sets, delegations and his governed actions.

title: Tenants
spec: Tenants with residency, status (Live · Stopped · Onboarding · Sandbox), level, chain head and mode per channel.

title: Tenant
spec: One tenant: residency domain, status, level, host, mode per channel, chain head and the stop switch.

title: Stop a tenant
spec: Stop Kaveri Spinning Mills: cause class and reason required, then a second-approver obligation opens; nothing stops until they decide.

title: Packs
spec: Installed and available packs — ledger1, invoice1, collect1 — with status, profile binding and T1–T8 progress.

title: Pack
spec: ledger1, the First India Pack, in its eleven blocks, with the buyer promise and what it does not establish always visible.

title: Install a pack
spec: Install ledger1: level check (L2 required), declaration match, proof_binding version certified under dual control, profile install, dry export, first bundle.

title: Lexicon
spec: The term set in force (rung1/erpnext/gst/2026-09) by hash, with its diff to the previous set.

title: Lexicon version
spec: A previous term set, kept verbatim with its hash.

title: Rule set
spec: Policy 11 as evaluated at rung 4: rules with ids, projection and the default no_rule_matched.

title: Erasure requests

title: Autonomy history
spec: Every grant change, graduation and revocation with who proposed, who approved, the effective seq and the counters at that moment.

title: Autonomy: action class
spec: One action class: current level per agent, the declaration’s minimum autonomy, caps (no reversal plan means no A3), and the history of changes.

title: Propose an autonomy change
spec: A governed write with dual control: class, current → proposed level, evidence snapshot, a justification the person writes (never pre-filled) and an approver who is not the proposer.

title: Graduation
spec: Which action classes have a record long enough to be considered for A3 — counters and thresholds only; a person writes the justification and a second person decides.

title: Graduation: action class
spec: All eleven counters, score_v1 with inputs and seq range, the eight eligibility conditions, the reversal drill date and a model summary labelled as model-written; states for not measurable and stale score.

title: Keys
src: E06 §07; E05; O03; atlas Fig 2; atlas Fig 16
spec: API keys, sandbox and production: class, prefix, environment, actor bound, scopes, created, last used, rotation window and status.

title: Key policy
spec: The KMS key policy and IAM policy verbatim, their change history, dual-control change records and the insider limitation stated unprompted.

title: Key
spec: Production token sk_live_…9c1e: bound actor and scopes, use over time, rotation window, and actions to rotate or revoke; never the secret.

title: Rotate a key
spec: Rotate a sandbox key yourself, or request production rotation from elan1 (two people review; the new key is shown once to the production owner).

title: Revoke a key

title: Channels
src: Channel Block; E05 §02; TM §6.3; atlas Fig 8

title: Channel
spec: WhatsApp (messaging): the write types it carries, approve-only cells, and “cannot be attempted from this route” where the matrix is blank.

title: Tools
spec: The MCP tool catalogue: 34 tools (18 read-only, 10 staging, 6 act) with descriptions pinned by hash.

title: Webhooks
spec: Where elan1 tells your systems what happened: endpoints, the seven events, signing secret rotation, last delivery and last seq, with seq-gap detection.

title: People
spec: The humans who submit, approve and certify, with roles and resolver sets — people only; an agent is never listed here.

title: Person
spec: Venkat Raman: roles, resolver sets, what he may approve, and his decisions with their proofs.

title: Roles
spec: Roles and what each may request, approve and certify; widening a role is its own governed write.

spec: “Can you show someone this was done properly?” The level card with what may be said at L1 Guarded, chain standing three-valued with scope and count, coverage, refusals this period, meter and mode summary — and what arrives at L2.

title: Proof log
spec: Every governed write’s hash-chained record, paged by seq: time, write type, actor and kind, autonomy, outcome with code, versions and short digest.

title: Proof record

spec: Proof #4,101: seq, digest and prev_digest, versions, actor kind, outcome, mode, the fields bound by proof_binding and all sixteen F-fields, the chain around it, and the L1 honesty line in the interface.

title: Write path inspector
spec: The nine rungs for one write — where it passed, stopped or escalated, with the gate rows and codes — for a commit, a refusal, an escalation or our failure.

title: Chain standing

title: Coverage
spec: Which of the 23 write types the evidence covers: live proof from this tenant apart from modelled proof from the reference tenant, with refusal codes seen.

title: Refusals
spec: “Refusals are evidence, not noise”: counts by class, code, rung and write type, platform failures apart as our failures, each at ₹0.

title: Refusal register
spec: The closed list of every way elan1 can say no: 43 codes (28 at L1), each with one rung, one class and one operator action.

title: Refusal code
spec: GATE.PRECONDITION_FAILED: meaning, rung 3 · G9, the operator action, verbatim copy and the refusals of this code on this tenant.

title: Enforcement
src: E05 §02; Four Doors v2.0; atlas Fig 8
spec: Mode per write type and channel — Enforced (credential custody or token acceptance) or Attested advisory — with the sentence each lets you say and the boundaries.

title: Assurance level
spec: What each level lets you say and not say, “what you may say to your regulator” at L1, and the L1 → L2 readiness items three-valued.

title: System map
spec: What runs behind this tenant, zoomable from context to components to planes; every box with what it does, its status and its last event.

title: Runtime
spec: Service health against SLO targets: evidence integrity pages someone, latency does not; the fail-closed matrix per dependency.

title: Residency
src: O05; Sovereign deployment guide; atlas Fig 12
spec: Where this tenant’s data lives: India, ap-south-1 Mumbai, three zones, retention by class, and what leaves India (nothing at L1).

title: Security
spec: Controls by layer, each with its evidence — a date and a link — or “not evidenced”; isolation tests, backups and the incident contact.

title: Access log

title: Incidents

title: L1 readiness
spec: The L1 definition of done, conformance C1–C14 and the operational bar — each passed, failed or not measured, with how we know; never a bare tick.

title: Meter
src: E06 §07; O07; TM §5; E10; atlas Fig 28
spec: Governed writes this period by write type with refusals at quantity zero on the same table, cost to date, and reconciliation status.

title: Meter line
spec: The records behind one invoice line: write id, seq, outcome, basis, quantity (0 for refusals) and price.

title: Invoices
spec: Invoices with refusals at ₹0 on the face; a period that has not reconciled is shown as blocked, not issued.

title: Invoice
spec: INV-KS-2026-09: platform floor, included volume, overage, “Refusals — at ₹0”, GST and total, each line with Show the records behind this line.

spec: L1 Guarded with ledger1: floor, included actions used, overage rate, contract dates and what each level would cost.

title: Change plan
spec: Move to L2 Attested: what changes from a named seq onward, the price delta and the boundary preview; moving level is a governed write with dual control.

title: Reconciliation
src: O07 §04; E11 test 3; TM §5.4; atlas Fig 28
spec: Nightly, both directions: every meter event to a record, every record to a meter event, and every change in ERPNext to a record.

title: Upgrade to Level 2
spec: The L1 → L2 runbook as the tenant sees it: what changes and what stays exactly as it was, the seven preconditions with evidence, the stage stepper and the customer communications.

title: Upgrade stage 0: pre-flight
spec: Full-chain replay (“continuous, 41,188 records”), key register and profile registry checks, and the head seq recorded.

title: Upgrade stage 1: key provisioning
spec: Bind the tenant to the domain key with signing still off; the fingerprint is published to the notice contact.

title: Upgrade stage 2: signing on
